**Signal Path** — single-stroke grid puzzle, true to the brief:

- **Loop**: Lighthouses on a grid call in order with foghorn tones — trace one continuous stroke (orthogonal grid moves) visiting them in that sequence. Lift to retry the stroke.
- **Escalation**: Round 1 starts with 3 targets / 30s on a 3×4 grid. Targets, grid size, horn cadence and time pressure all ramp. Round 5+ adds **bridges** (must be crossed twice — shown with double-ring + dot indicators).
- **Memory**: Numbers visible during the call sequence + 1.4s into play, then fade — the next-target hint pulse stays subtle until you've completed at least one.
- **Aesthetic**: Watercolor wash blobs (paper-cell tinted, stable per session) + grain + soft vignette; thin ink trails with bleed; tiny lighthouse rings. Swiss-modern HUD with monospace tabular numbers. Both color schemes tuned, no purple anywhere.
- **Audio**: Web Audio sine-pair foghorns (pitch climbs with target order), node-visit blips, ascending completion chime, buzz on fail. Haptics on visits/wins/fails.
- **Mobile-first**: 100dvw/100dvh, viewport-fit cover, `touch-action: none` on canvas, pointer events with touch fallback, 44px+ buttons, safe-area insets respected. Keyboard (Space/Enter) starts/restarts.
- **Loss/restart**: 3 lives, time bar drains; "RUN AGAIN" button on game over.
